free_findings.cause: Batch validation compares each line against the same initial stock snapshot without subtracting quantities from earlier lines for that SKU.
free_findings.impact: A successful batch can oversell inventory and commit negative available stock instead of rejecting the entire request.
free_findings.trigger: With A stock of 10, submit two lines resolving to A with quantities 6 and 6. Both validations pass and the committed available quantity becomes -2. Different catalog aliases resolving to A have the same problem.
free_findings.evidence: At 41c8c08a85e184017f6d0ea275abf2ad1622d776, allocation.py:19-22 validates against an unchanged per-SKU snapshot, then lines 24-26 apply every deduction. api.py:27 resolves aliases before allocation; catalog.py:9-11 permits multiple aliases to resolve to one SKU. The supplied tests cover distinct SKUs but omit cumulative demand for a shared SKU.

free_findings.cause: Quantity replacement updates stock and reservations.quantity but leaves the scheduled releases.quantity unchanged.
free_findings.impact: Expiry returns the original quantity, permanently corrupting available inventory after an adjustment.
free_findings.trigger: Starting with A stock of 10, reserve 4 until 100, replace its quantity with 2, then expire at 100. Available inventory rises from 8 to 12. Increasing the reservation to 5 instead leaves only 9 available after expiry.
free_findings.evidence: At 41c8c08a85e184017f6d0ea275abf2ad1622d776, allocation.py:38-43 updates only stock and the reservation row. repository.py:40-43 stores the original scheduled release quantity, and expiry.py:7-13 reads and returns that stored quantity. test_reservations.py:47-53 and 70-75 stop before expiry.

free_findings.cause: Replacement checks only the persisted active flag and never establishes that the reservation deadline is still in the future.
free_findings.impact: Quantity changes can succeed after expiry, contrary to the requirement that adjustments apply before expiry. A single dispatch thread does not guarantee that the expiry worker has already processed every due reservation.
free_findings.trigger: A reservation expires at integer timestamp 100. Dispatch replace at timestamp 100 or later before the expiry worker processes that reservation; its active flag remains 1 and the adjustment is accepted.
free_findings.evidence: At 41c8c08a85e184017f6d0ea275abf2ad1622d776, allocation.py:29-36 has no deadline comparison or current-time input. api.py:20-23 forwards replacement directly. expiry.py:7-14 deactivates due reservations only when explicitly invoked. The requirements restrict quantity changes to before expiry.
